name: Spaghetti bolognese (about 45 minutes)
title: Spaghetti bolognese

steps.text: Finely chop the onion, carrot and garlic.
Big pan, 1 tbsp oil, medium heat. Onion and carrot in for 5 minutes until soft. Garlic in for 1 minute.
Turn the heat up. Mince in. Break it up and brown it for 6 to 8 minutes.
Tomato puree, chopped tomatoes, stock cube (crumbled), oregano, 100 ml water. Stir, season, bring to a gentle bubble.
Heat down to low. Leave to simmer, lid half on, stir now and then.
Big pan of water on, high heat, with a good pinch of salt.
Water boiling: spaghetti in. Tap DONE when it goes in, the rest follows. Cook as the packet says (gluten-free spaghetti: watch the time, about 10 minutes).
Drain the spaghetti. Keep a cup of the water. Taste the sauce and fix the salt and pepper.
Spaghetti onto plates, sauce on top. Parmesan for the others if they want it.

prep: Big pan and a pasta pan out
Parmesan to grate for the others (optional)
shopping: 1 beef stock cube (check it is gluten-free)
250 g gluten-free spaghetti (one person avoids gluten)
parmesan for the others only (one person avoids dairy)
equipment: a large frying pan or saucepan
